Kanji through 3rd grade

All 440 kanji taught in Japanese elementary school years 1–3, ordered by how often they appear in newspaper text — most common first. Numbers on each diagram give the stroke order. Tick them off as you learn to write them.

日
day / sun#1 G14 strokes
ON ニチ　ジツ  KUN ひ　び　か
A picture of the sun. The old form was a circle with a dot in the middle; the brush squared the circle off, and the dot became the line inside.
日ひday; sun
今日きょうtoday
日本にほんJapan
一
one#2 G11 stroke
ON イチ　イツ  KUN ひと　ひと・つ
One finger laid flat on the table. One stroke, one thing — the simplest kanji there is.
一つひとつone (thing)
一人ひとりone person; alone
一番いちばんnumber one; the most
国
country#3 G28 strokes
ON コク  KUN くに
A jewel (玉) locked inside a border wall (囗). A country is its treasure, kept safe inside its borders.
国くにcountry
外国がいこくforeign country
国会こっかいthe Diet (Japan's parliament)
会
meet / association#4 G26 strokes
ON カイ　エ  KUN あ・う　あ・わせる　あつ・まる
People (人) gathering under one roof, with 云 (a cloud of chatter) underneath. A meeting.
会うあうto meet
会社かいしゃcompany
社会しゃかいsociety
人
person#5 G12 strokes
ON ジン　ニン  KUN ひと　り　と
A person seen from the side, mid-stride — two legs walking.
人ひとperson
日本人にほんじんJapanese person
二人ふたりtwo people
年
year#6 G16 strokes
ON ネン  KUN とし
A person carrying the harvested grain home on their back. One harvest = one year.
年としyear; age
今年ことしthis year
去年きょねんlast year
大
big#7 G13 strokes
ON ダイ　タイ  KUN おお　おお・きい　おお・いに
A person (人) standing with both arms thrown out wide — "it was THIS big!"
大きいおおきいbig; large
大学だいがくuniversity
大人おとなadult
十
ten#8 G12 strokes
ON ジュウ　ジッ　ジュッ  KUN とお　と　そ
Two hands crossed over each other — all ten fingers, complete.
十じゅうten
十日とおかthe 10th; ten days
十分じゅうぶんenough; sufficient
二
two#9 G12 strokes
ON ニ　ジ  KUN ふた　ふた・つ　ふたたび
Two fingers laid flat, one above the other. Two strokes, two.
二つふたつtwo (things)
二人ふたりtwo people
二月にがつFebruary
本
book / origin / main#10 G15 strokes
ON ホン  KUN もと
A tree (木) with a mark at its base — pointing at the ROOT, the origin. The paper for books comes from that same tree.
本ほんbook
日本にほんJapan
本当ほんとうtrue; really
中
middle / inside#11 G14 strokes
ON チュウ  KUN なか　うち　あた・る
A line driven straight through the centre of a box — dead centre.
中なかinside; middle
中学校ちゅうがっこうjunior high school
一日中いちにちじゅうall day long
長
long / chief#12 G28 strokes
ON チョウ  KUN なが・い　おさ
An elder with long flowing hair leaning on a stick. Long hair, long life — and so, the leader.
長いながいlong
社長しゃちょうcompany president
校長こうちょうschool principal
出
exit / go out#13 G15 strokes
ON シュツ　スイ  KUN で・る　で　だ・す
One mountain (山) stacked on another — pushing UP and OUT of the ground.
出るでるto go out; to leave
出すだすto take out; to submit
出口でぐちexit
三
three#14 G13 strokes
ON サン　ゾウ  KUN み　み・つ　みっ・つ
Three fingers laid flat, one above the other. Note the proportions when you write it: the middle stroke is the shortest and the bottom stroke the longest, so the character sits steady rather than toppling.
三つみっつthree (things)
三人さんにんthree people
三月さんがつMarch
同
same#15 G26 strokes
ON ドウ  KUN おな・じ
One (一) mouth (口) speaking from under the same roof (冂) — everyone saying the same thing.
同じおなじthe same
同時どうじat the same time
同級生どうきゅうせいclassmate
時
time / hour#16 G210 strokes
ON ジ  KUN とき　どき
The sun (日) over the temple (寺) — the temple bell marks the hour by the sun.
時ときtime; when
時間じかんtime; an hour
何時なんじwhat time
事
matter / thing#17 G38 strokes
ON ジ　ズ  KUN こと　つか・う　つか・える
A hand (⺕) holding a brush straight down, recording the affairs of state. Business, matters, things.
事ことthing; matter (abstract)
仕事しごとwork; job
食事しょくじmeal
自
self#18 G26 strokes
ON ジ　シ  KUN みずか・ら　おの・ずから　おの・ずと
Originally a drawing of a nose. In Japan people point at their own nose to mean "me".
自分じぶんoneself; myself
自動車じどうしゃautomobile
自由じゆうfreedom
行
go / line#19 G26 strokes
ON コウ　ギョウ　アン  KUN い・く　ゆ・く　ゆ・き
A crossroads seen from above — the place where you GO one way or the other.
行くいくto go
銀行ぎんこうbank
旅行りょこうtravel; trip
社
company / shrine#20 G27 strokes
ON シャ  KUN やしろ
The altar radical (礻) beside earth (土) — a mound of sacred earth, a shrine. Companies grew out of these local associations.
会社かいしゃcompany
社会しゃかいsociety
神社じんじゃShinto shrine
見
see#21 G17 strokes
ON ケン  KUN み・る　み・える　み・せる
A big eye (目) up on a pair of legs (儿) — an eye walking around, looking at everything.
見るみるto see; to watch
見せるみせるto show
意見いけんopinion
月
month / moon#22 G14 strokes
ON ゲツ　ガツ  KUN つき
A crescent moon on its side. One moon-cycle = one month.
月つきmoon
月曜日げつようびMonday
今月こんげつthis month
分
divide / minute / understand#23 G24 strokes
ON ブン　フン　ブ  KUN わ・ける　わ・け　わ・かれる
A sword (刀) cutting something into eight (八) parts — dividing. Once it is divided up, you can understand it.
分かるわかるto understand
分けるわけるto divide; to share out
五分ごふんfive minutes
後
after / behind#24 G29 strokes
ON ゴ　コウ  KUN のち　うし・ろ　あと
Walking (彳) with a thread (幺) dragging behind slow feet (夂) — you fall BEHIND, you come AFTER.
後ろうしろbehind; the back
午後ごごafternoon; p.m.
後であとでlater
前
before / in front#25 G29 strokes
ON ゼン  KUN まえ
A knife (刂) trimming the meat (月) into eight (八) — you cut it BEFORE serving. What is cut goes out FRONT.
前まえin front; before
午前ごぜんmorning; a.m.
名前なまえname
生
life / birth / raw#26 G15 strokes
ON セイ　ショウ  KUN い・きる　い・かす　い・ける
A young plant pushing up out of the ground (土) — new life sprouting.
生まれるうまれるto be born
生きるいきるto live
先生せんせいteacher
五
five#27 G14 strokes
ON ゴ  KUN いつ　いつ・つ
An hourglass pinched between two lines — a hand with all five fingers folded in.
五ついつつfive (things)
五人ごにんfive people
五月ごがつMay
発
depart / emit#28 G39 strokes
ON ハツ　ホツ  KUN た・つ　あば・く　おこ・る
Two feet stepping apart (癶) above a bow being loosed — the arrow is DISCHARGED and DEPARTS.
発表はっぴょうannouncement; presentation
出発しゅっぱつdeparture
発見はっけんdiscovery
間
interval / between#29 G212 strokes
ON カン　ケン  KUN あいだ　ま　あい
The sun (日) shining through a gate (門) — the GAP between the two doors.
間あいだbetween; interval
時間じかんtime; hour
人間にんげんhuman being
対
opposite / versus#30 G37 strokes
ON タイ　ツイ  KUN あいて　こた・える　そろ・い
A text (文) and a hand (寸) facing each other across a table — two sides FACING off.
反対はんたいopposition; the opposite
対するたいするto face; regarding
絶対ぜったいabsolutely
上
above / up#31 G13 strokes
ON ジョウ　ショウ　シャン  KUN うえ　うわ　かみ
A ground line with a mark standing UP above it. Write the tall vertical first, then the short right-hand tick, then the base line last — and remember it as the exact mirror of 下, which hangs its mark below the line instead.
上うえabove; on top
上がるあがるto go up; to rise
上手じょうずskilful; good at
部
section / department#32 G311 strokes
ON ブ  KUN べ
A village (⻏) split into standing (立) mouths (口) — the town divided into DEPARTMENTS.
部屋へやroom
全部ぜんぶall; everything
部長ぶちょうdepartment head
東
east#33 G28 strokes
ON トウ  KUN ひがし
The sun (日) caught in the branches of a tree (木) — sunrise seen through the trees is the EAST.
東ひがしeast
東京とうきょうTokyo
東口ひがしぐちeast exit
者
person (-er)#34 G38 strokes
ON シャ  KUN もの
An elder (耂) speaking over the sun (日) — the one who does the telling. This is the "-er" on the end of a job.
者ものperson (formal/humble)
医者いしゃdoctor
若者わかものyoung person
地
ground / earth#35 G26 strokes
ON チ　ジ  KUN —
Earth (土) plus 也 — soil stretching out flat in every direction.
地図ちずmap
地下ちかunderground
地方ちほうregion; the provinces
合
fit / join#36 G26 strokes
ON ゴウ　ガッ　カッ  KUN あ・う　あ・い　あ・わす
A lid coming down neatly onto a pot (口) — it FITS perfectly.

場合ばあいcase; situation
試合しあいmatch; game
市
city / market#37 G25 strokes
ON シ  KUN いち
A cloth banner (巾) hanging under a lid — the flag over the marketplace, which grew into the CITY.

市民しみんcitizen; resident
市役所しやくしょcity hall

business / vocation#38 G313 strokes
ON ギョウ　ゴウ  KUN わざ
A heavy wooden rack piled high with work — the craftsman's loaded bench. That is his TRADE.

卒業そつぎょうgraduation

inside#39 G24 strokes
ON ナイ　ダイ  KUN うち
A person (人) tucked in under a roof (冂) — safely INSIDE.
内うちinside; within
案内あんないguidance; showing around
国内こくないdomestic; within the country
相
mutual / minister#40 G39 strokes
ON ソウ　ショウ  KUN あい
An eye (目) looking at a tree (木) — and the tree "looks" back. Two things facing EACH OTHER.

相談そうだんconsultation; discussion
首相しゅしょうprime minister
方
direction / person (polite)#41 G24 strokes
ON ホウ  KUN かた　がた
A plough turning at the end of a furrow — it points the way. The DIRECTION you turn.

方法ほうほうmethod; way
夕方ゆうがたevening
四
four#42 G15 strokes
ON シ  KUN よ　よ・つ　よっ・つ
A mouth (囗) with two legs hanging inside — four was too many strokes to draw, so they boxed it in.

四人よにんfour people
四月しがつApril

determine / fix#43 G38 strokes
ON テイ　ジョウ  KUN さだ・める　さだ・まる　さだ・か
Under a roof (宀) a foot comes to rest — you stop wandering and SETTLE the matter.
定めるさだめるto lay down; to establish
予定よていplan; schedule
決定けっていdecision
今
now#44 G24 strokes
ON コン　キン  KUN いま
A roof over a single mark — this very moment, caught and held under cover.

今度こんどnext time; this time
今週こんしゅうthis week

times / revolve#45 G26 strokes
ON カイ　エ  KUN まわ・る　まわ・り　まわ・す
A box inside a box, spiralling inward — going round and round.

一回いっかいonce; one time
今回こんかいthis time

new#46 G213 strokes
ON シン  KUN あたら・しい　あら・た　あら
An axe (斤) cutting a standing (立) tree (木) — freshly cut timber is NEW wood.

place#47 G212 strokes
ON ジョウ　チョウ  KUN ば
Earth (土) where the sun (日) beats down on open ground — a wide, flat PLACE.

会場かいじょうvenue

gold / money#48 G18 strokes
ON キン　コン　ゴン  KUN かね　かな　がね
A roof over the earth with two nuggets buried underneath — metal in the ground. Gold, and so money.

member / staff#49 G310 strokes
ON イン  KUN —
A mouth (口) above a shell of money (貝) — one more mouth on the payroll. A member of staff.

nine#50 G12 strokes

stand#52 G15 strokes

A person standing on the ground line, feet planted apart.

立てるたてるto stand (sth) up; to make (a plan)

open#53 G312 strokes
ON カイ  KUN ひら・く　ひら・き　びら・き
Two hands lifting the bar off a gate (門) — swinging it OPEN.

開くひらくto open; to hold (an event)

hand#54 G14 strokes

A hand with the fingers and wrist drawn in — the long hook is the arm.

手紙てがみletter

rice / America#55 G26 strokes
ON ベイ　マイ　メエトル  KUN こめ　よね
Grains of rice scattered off the stalk in all four directions.

A flexed arm with the muscle bulging — or a plough biting the earth. Raw STRENGTH.

study / learning#57 G18 strokes
ON ガク  KUN まな・ぶ
A child (子) under a roof with knowledge sprinkled on top — a child at school.

学校がっこうschool
科学かがくscience

question / ask#58 G311 strokes

A mouth (口) at the gate (門) — knocking and ASKING to be let in.

質問しつもんquestion

ON コウ  KUN たか・い　たか　だか
A tall watchtower with a roof, a window, and a gate below — a HIGH building.

明
bright / clear#61 G28 strokes
ON メイ　ミョウ　ミン  KUN あ・かり　あか・るい　あか・るむ
The sun (日) and the moon (月) side by side — the two brightest things there are.

reality / fruit#62 G38 strokes
ON ジツ　シツ  KUN み　みの・る　まこと
Under a roof (宀), the harvest hangs heavy — the real FRUIT of the year. What is actually there.

circle / yen#63 G14 strokes
ON エン  KUN まる・い　まる　まど
A round enclosure with a line inside — a coin. Japan's money is literally "the round thing".

decide#64 G37 strokes
ON ケツ  KUN き・める　ぎ・め　き・まる
Water (氵) bursting through a dam — once the bank breaks the matter is SETTLED, no going back.

決まるきまるto be decided
解決かいけつsolution; resolution

child#65 G13 strokes
ON シ　ス　ツ  KUN こ　ね
A baby in swaddling clothes, arms out, legs wrapped together.
子どもこどもchild
男の子おとこのこboy
女の子おんなのこgirl
動
move#66 G311 strokes
ON ドウ  KUN うご・く　うご・かす
Something heavy (重) plus strength (力) — put your back into it and it MOVES.

運動うんどうexercise; movement
京
capital#67 G28 strokes
ON キョウ　ケイ　キン  KUN みやこ
A tall gate-tower standing over the city — the grandest building, in the CAPITAL.

whole / all#68 G36 strokes
ON ゼン  KUN まった・く　すべ・て

全然ぜんぜんnot at all
安全あんぜんsafety
目
eye#69 G15 strokes
ON モク　ボク  KUN め　ま
An eye stood on its end — the two lines inside are the pupil and lid.
目めeye
目的もくてきpurpose; aim
目立つめだつto stand out
表
surface / express / table#70 G38 strokes
ON ヒョウ  KUN おもて　あらわ・す　あらわ・れる

表現ひょうげんexpression

ON ツウ　ツ  KUN とお・る　とお・り　どお・り
A road (⻌) running straight through — traffic PASSING along it.

outside#72 G25 strokes

Evening (夕) plus a fortune stick (卜) — telling fortunes after dark, out beyond the walls.

say / word#73 G27 strokes

logic / reason#74 G211 strokes
ON リ  KUN ことわり
A jewel (王) being polished along the grain of the field (里) — following the natural LOGIC of the thing.

investigate / tune#75 G315 strokes
ON チョウ  KUN しら・べる　しら・べ　ととの・う
Words (言) going all the way round (周) a thing — checking it from every side.

ON リ  KUN さと
A field 田 resting on the earth 土. Where the fields are worked, people settle down — the village, and the home place you go back to.
里さとvillage; parents' home
里帰りさとがえりvisit to one's parents
里親さとおやfoster parent
歯
tooth#389 G312 strokes
ON シ  KUN よわい　は　よわい・する
止 sits on top just to lend the sound; underneath, the open mouth 凵 holds rows of teeth drawn as 米. Draw the mouth, then fill it with teeth.
歯はtooth
歯医者はいしゃdentist
虫歯むしばcavity
昼
daytime / noon#390 G29 strokes
ON チュウ  KUN ひる
尺, a hand measuring a span, laid over 旦 — the sun 日 sitting on the horizon 一. Measuring off the stretch of the day the sun is up gives you midday.
昼ひるnoon; daytime
昼休みひるやすみlunch break
昼食ちゅうしょくlunch
茶
tea#391 G29 strokes
ON チャ　サ  KUN —
The grass crown 艹 over a person 人 standing under a tree 木. Leaves picked from the bush and carried home to be brewed: tea.
お茶おちゃtea
茶色ちゃいろbrown
紅茶こうちゃblack tea
柱
pillar / post#392 G39 strokes
ON チュウ  KUN はしら
Wood 木 beside 主, master — a lamp flame 丶 above the stand 王. The piece of timber that is master of the house is the pillar holding it up.
柱はしらpillar; post
電柱でんちゅうutility pole
大黒柱だいこくばしらbreadwinner; main pillar
祭
festival / rite#393 G311 strokes
ON サイ  KUN まつ・る　まつ・り
A piece of meat 月 and a hand held above the altar 示. Meat set on the altar by hand is an offering, and the offering is the festival.
祭りまつりfestival
祭るまつるto enshrine
夏祭りなつまつりsummer festival
雪
snow#394 G211 strokes
ON セツ  KUN ゆき
Rain 雨 on top and the hand-with-a-broom ⺕ underneath. Snow is the rain you have to sweep off the path.
雪ゆきsnow
大雪おおゆきheavy snow
初雪はつゆきfirst snow
筆
writing brush#395 G312 strokes
ON ヒツ  KUN ふで
Bamboo 竹 on top and 聿 below: a hand ⺕ gripping an upright shaft 丨. A hand holding a bamboo shaft is a writing brush.
筆ふでwriting brush
鉛筆えんぴつpencil
筆記ひっきwriting; note-taking
童
child#396 G312 strokes
ON ドウ  KUN わらべ
立, a person standing, set on top of 里, the village. The small ones standing about in the village are the children.
児童じどうchildren; pupils
童話どうわfairy tale
童謡どうようchildren's song
弟
younger brother#397 G27 strokes
ON テイ　ダイ　デ  KUN おとうと
A cord wound in order around a stake, the loops shown by 弓 and 丨 and the little tail 丿 at the end. Things wound in order gave the sense of the one who comes next: the younger brother.
弟おとうとyounger brother
兄弟きょうだいsiblings
弟子でしpupil; apprentice
畑
dry field / farm#398 G39 strokes
ON —  KUN はた　はたけ　ばたけ
Fire 火 beside a field 田. Land cleared by burning it off grows vegetables and wheat rather than rice. This character was made in Japan.
畑はたけfield; farm plot
田畑たはたfields and paddies
花畑はなばたけflower field
毛
hair / fur#399 G24 strokes
ON モウ  KUN け
Three strokes of a tuft, and the last one bends and curls up at the tip. That flick at the end is what makes it hair rather than a straight line.
毛けhair; fur
毛布もうふblanket
髪の毛かみのけhair (on the head)
緑
green#400 G314 strokes
ON リョク　ロク  KUN みどり
Thread 糸 beside 彔: a hand ⺕ squeezing a plant so the juice 氺 runs out below. The dye pressed out of leaves colors the thread green.
緑みどりgreen; greenery
緑色みどりいろgreen (color)
緑茶りょくちゃgreen tea
礼
bow / thanks#401 G35 strokes
ON レイ　ライ  KUN —
The altar radical 礻 on the left, and on the right 乙, a figure bent over at the waist. Bowing before the altar is what courtesy and thanks look like.
礼れいthanks; a bow
お礼おれいthanks; a thank-you gift
失礼しつれいrudeness; excuse me
詩
poem#402 G313 strokes
ON シ  KUN うた
Words 言 on the left, temple 寺 on the right — earth 土 sitting above a hand 寸. Words measured out and chanted at a temple: a poem.
詩しpoem; poetry
詩人しじんpoet
詩集ししゅうpoetry collection
昔
long ago#403 G38 strokes
ON セキ　シャク  KUN むかし
A sun 日 at the bottom with strokes piled on top of it — 廾 crossed by 十. Day stacked on day on day until they add up to the distant past.
昔むかしlong ago; the past
昔話むかしばなしfolk tale; old story
大昔おおむかしancient times
牛
cow#404 G24 strokes
ON ギュウ  KUN うし
A cow seen head-on: one horn slanting off to the left, the other horn as the crossbar, and the body running straight down. It is 午 with the top stroke pushed to the side.
牛うしcow; cattle
牛乳ぎゅうにゅうmilk
牛肉ぎゅうにくbeef
魚
fish#405 G211 strokes
ON ギョ  KUN うお　さかな　ざかな
The head is the 𠂊 on top, the scaly body is the 田 in the middle, and the tail fins spread out as the four dots 灬 at the bottom.
魚さかなfish
焼き魚やきざかなgrilled fish
金魚きんぎょgoldfish
兄
older brother#406 G25 strokes
ON ケイ　キョウ  KUN あに
A mouth 口 sitting on top of a pair of legs 儿. The one in the family who stands up and does the talking is your big brother.
兄あにolder brother
お兄さんおにいさんolder brother (polite)
兄弟きょうだいsiblings; brothers
泳
swim#407 G38 strokes
ON エイ  KUN およ・ぐ
Water 氵 beside 永 'long', which is itself water 水 with an extra drop added on top. Moving a long way through the water is swimming.
泳ぐおよぐto swim
水泳すいえいswimming
泳ぎおよぎswimming; a swim
荷
load / luggage#408 G310 strokes
ON カ  KUN に
Grass 艹 laid over 何 'what' — a person 亻 next to 可. What is that person carrying on their back? A load.
荷物にもつluggage; package
手荷物てにもつhand luggage
荷にload; cargo
黄
yellow#409 G211 strokes
ON コウ　オウ  KUN き　こ
龷 across the top, a stalk in a field 由 through the middle, and 八 spread out below like two legs. Stand it up and picture a farmer in ripe, yellow grain.
黄色きいろyellow
黄色いきいろいyellow (adjective)
黄身きみegg yolk
雲
cloud#410 G212 strokes
ON ウン  KUN くも　ぐも
Rain 雨 on top of 云 — a 二 with 厶 tucked under it, the old drawing of vapor curling upward. The cloud is what the rain sits inside.
雲くもcloud
雨雲あまぐもrain cloud
入道雲にゅうどうぐもthunderhead
鳴
cry / ring#411 G214 strokes
ON メイ  KUN な・く　な・る　な・らす
A mouth 口 beside a bird 鳥, whose tail feathers are the four dots 灬 underneath. A bird opening its mouth: it sings, and anything else that sounds off.
鳴るなるto ring; to sound
鳴くなくto chirp; to cry (animal)
鳴らすならすto ring (something)
矢
arrow#412 G25 strokes
ON シ  KUN や
Almost 大, but with a short stroke laid across the top: that is the notch and the feathers, and the long stroke down the middle is the shaft.
矢やarrow
矢印やじるしarrow (symbol)
弓矢ゆみやbow and arrow
炭
charcoal / coal#413 G39 strokes
ON タン  KUN すみ
A mountain 山 sitting on top of ash 灰 — a cliff 厂 with fire 火 burning under it. Fire under the hillside leaves charcoal behind.
炭すみcharcoal
石炭せきたんcoal
炭火すみびcharcoal fire
丁
block / ward#414 G32 strokes
ON チョウ　テイ　チン  KUN ひのと
A single line 一 with a hook 亅 dropping from the middle: a nail seen from the side. Towns are nailed down into numbered blocks.
丁目ちょうめcity block (in an address)
丁寧ていねいpolite; careful
包丁ほうちょうkitchen knife
犬
dog#415 G14 strokes
ON ケン  KUN いぬ
A big 大 with a dot added at the shoulder — the ear flicked up, or the tag on its collar. That one dot is all that separates a dog from 大.
犬いぬdog
子犬こいぬpuppy
番犬ばんけんguard dog
耳
ear#416 G16 strokes
ON ジ  KUN みみ
A picture of an ear: the long stroke down the right is the outer rim, and the crossbars inside are the folds of cartilage.
耳みみear
耳鼻科じびかENT clinic
初耳はつみみnews to me
湖
lake#417 G312 strokes
ON コ  KUN みずうみ
Water 氵 beside 胡 — old 古, a ten 十 over a mouth 口, standing next to a moon 月. Old water lying still enough to hold the moon.
湖みずうみlake
湖畔こはんlakeside
湖水こすいlake water
虫
insect#418 G16 strokes
ON チュウ　キ  KUN むし
It began as a coiled snake. Now write 中 and add the short stroke on the right: a small creature curled around a center point.
虫むしinsect; bug
虫歯むしばcavity; tooth decay
昆虫こんちゅうinsect (formal)
湯
hot water#419 G312 strokes
ON トウ  KUN ゆ
Water 氵 beside 昜: the sun 日 rising above the horizon line 一 with its rays 勿 streaming down. Sun-heated water is hot water.
湯ゆhot water
お湯おゆhot water (polite)
湯気ゆげsteam
箱
box#420 G315 strokes
ON ソウ  KUN はこ
Bamboo 竹 over 相 — a tree 木 beside an eye 目. Bamboo strips woven into a chest, and an eye kept on what is inside it.
箱はこbox
ゴミ箱ごみばこtrash can
本箱ほんばこbookcase
豆
bean#421 G37 strokes
ON トウ　ズ  KUN まめ
Originally a footed serving dish: a lid across the top, the bowl drawn as a mouth 口, and the stand underneath. What was served in it — beans — took over the character.
豆まめbean
大豆だいずsoybean
納豆なっとうnatto
暑
hot (weather)#422 G312 strokes
ON ショ  KUN あつ・い
The sun 日 sitting right on top of 者 'person' — the 耂 top over earth 土. The sun beating down on someone out in the open: summer heat.
暑いあついhot (weather)
暑さあつさthe heat
蒸し暑いむしあついhumid and hot
妹
younger sister#423 G28 strokes
ON マイ  KUN いもうと
A woman 女 beside 未 'not yet' — a tree 木 whose top branch is still short and unfinished. The girl in the family who has not yet grown up.
妹いもうとyounger sister
妹さんいもうとさんyour younger sister
姉妹しまいsisters
氷
ice#424 G35 strokes
ON ヒョウ  KUN こおり　ひ　こお・る
Water 水 with one extra stroke added at the top left — a crack, or a splinter, frozen into the surface.
氷こおりice
かき氷かきごおりshaved ice
氷水こおりみずice water
寒
cold#425 G312 strokes
ON カン  KUN さむ・い
Under a roof 宀 someone has stuffed straw for insulation — the 三 crossed by strokes with 八 below — and two ice marks 冫 sit at the very bottom. Ice indoors: freezing.
寒いさむいcold
寒ささむさthe cold
寒気さむけchills; the shivers
帳
notebook / ledger#426 G311 strokes
ON チョウ  KUN とばり
A cloth 巾 that is long 長. First a long hanging curtain, then the long folded cloth you keep your accounts on.
手帳てちょうpocket notebook
通帳つうちょうbankbook
記帳きちょうmaking an entry; updating a passbook
姉
older sister#427 G28 strokes
ON シ  KUN あね　はは
A woman 女 beside a market 市 — a lid 亠 over a cloth 巾. The older girl is the one trusted to go to the market.
姉あねolder sister
お姉さんおねえさんolder sister (polite)
姉妹しまいsisters
拾
pick up#428 G39 strokes
ON シュウ　ジュウ  KUN ひろ・う
A hand 扌 beside 合 'to fit together' — a lid 人 over 一 over a mouth 口. Your hand closes over something on the ground and lifts it.
拾うひろうto pick up
拾い物ひろいものa find; lucky find
収拾しゅうしゅうbringing under control
漢
China / Han#429 G313 strokes
ON カン  KUN —
Water 氵 on the left for the Han river; on the right grass 艹 over a mouth 口 over a man 夫. From that river came the name of the Han people and their writing.
漢字かんじkanji
漢方かんぽうChinese herbal medicine
漢語かんごSino-Japanese vocabulary
糸
thread#430 G16 strokes
ON シ  KUN いと
A skein of silk: the little loops twisted at the top, and the loose ends hanging down as the three short strokes below.
糸いとthread
毛糸けいとwool yarn
糸口いとぐちclue; opening
才
talent / years old#431 G23 strokes
ON サイ  KUN —
Almost the hand radical 扌, but the hook 亅 cuts straight through the crossbar: a sprout pushing up out of the ground. Ability that was there from the start.
才能さいのうtalent
天才てんさいgenius
才さいyears old
麦
wheat / barley#432 G27 strokes
ON バク  KUN むぎ
龶 on top — the ear of grain, three strokes crossed by a vertical — and a foot 夂 stepping below. Winter wheat is the crop you walk out and tread down.
麦むぎwheat; barley
小麦こむぎwheat
麦茶むぎちゃbarley tea
鼻
nose#433 G314 strokes
ON ビ  KUN はな
自 on top was itself the original drawing of a nose. Once 自 was taken over to mean 'self', a base was built under it: a field 田 on a stand 廾.
鼻はなnose
鼻水はなみずrunny nose
鼻血はなぢnosebleed
貝
shellfish / shell#434 G17 strokes
ON バイ  KUN かい
An eye 目 standing on two legs 八 — really a cowrie shell, its slit down the middle and its feelers trailing below. Shells were money, which is why 貝 hides inside 買 and 貨.

巻貝まきがいspiral shell; snail

sword#435 G22 strokes
ON トウ  KUN かたな　そり
Two strokes only: the curved back of the blade, and the handle hooking down from it. Squeeze the same shape thin and it becomes the 刂 on the right of 切 and 別.

小刀こがたなsmall knife
弓
bow (archery)#436 G23 strokes
ON キュウ  KUN ゆみ
The curve of a bow seen from the side, drawn in three strokes. The string is left off so you can see the wood bending.
弓ゆみbow (weapon)
弓道きゅうどうJapanese archery
弓矢ゆみやbow and arrow
皿
plate / dish#437 G35 strokes
ON ベイ  KUN さら
A dish seen from the side: the flat rim across the top, the two walls coming down, and the base line closing it underneath.
皿さらplate; dish
お皿おさらplate (polite)
小皿こざらsmall plate
羊
sheep#438 G36 strokes
ON ヨウ  KUN ひつじ
Two horns 䒑 curling outward at the top, then the body: three crossbars strung on a spine. A sheep seen head-on.
羊ひつじsheep
羊毛ようもうwool
子羊こひつじlamb
笛
flute / whistle#439 G311 strokes
ON テキ  KUN ふえ
Bamboo 竹 over 由: a length of bamboo with a hole bored through it. That hole is the whole reason it makes a sound.
笛ふえflute; whistle
口笛くちぶえwhistling
警笛けいてきhorn; warning whistle
汽
steam#440 G27 strokes
ON キ  KUN —
Water 氵 next to 气, breath rising in three trailing strokes under its 𠂉 top. Water turned into breath: steam.
汽車きしゃsteam train
